method: Round 3. Each value was read with WebFetch at least twice using differently-worded prompts asking for verbatim table rows/sentences. agreed=true only when the printed value matched in both reads. WebFetch returns a small-model rendering of the page text, not the raw file: these are transcriptions, not file reads; cite as hand-transcribed (page/table/row) and upgrade to pdftotext/xlsx/csv reads when files are staged. Where the tool rendered a table instead of quoting lines, the quote field says so. Derived numbers in notes are builder arithmetic, not printed values.

values.unit: MMT CO2 Eq. (million metric tons CO2-equivalent), calendar year 2022

basis.gwp_set: IPCC AR5 100-yr (chapter footnote 4: 'this Inventory report presents CO2 equivalent values based on the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (AR5) GWP values'; the numeric CH4 GWP (28 in AR5 without climate-carbon feedback) is not printed in the text read)
basis.boundary: CH4 only from U.S. coal mining source category (1B1a): active underground mining (net of methane recovered and used), surface mining, and post-mining (underground and surface) per the GHGI category structure. EXCLUDES abandoned underground coal mines (separate row, 6.3 MMT CO2 Eq. in 2022, single read), EXCLUDES mining energy CO2 and coal transport CO2. Covers all U.S. coal produced (including exports), not only power-plant coal.

values.notes: The detailed coal-mining table (underground liberated / recovered & used / surface / post-mining split, Section 3.4) could NOT be read: WebFetch text of both the final (2024-04) and the public-review draft (2024-02) chapter stops in Section 3.1 at about p. 3-34 (102,557 characters). So only the total is registered; the split ids epa_ghgi.2022.coal_mining_ch4_underground/_surface/_post_mining are gaps.
